source_notes.explanation: The enlarged length crop shows RICHI-200. An initial page-scale impression of 300 was rejected before publication; no 100-coordinate-loss model is adopted.
The first glyph in BVAGD is visibly B, outside the ADFGVX alphabet. It occupies one source slot and is masked, not deleted. The edited N in NR is a contextual choice from its six-letter domain.

opaque_inner_group_sequence.scope: These are recovered outer-ADFGVX plaintext labels. Their possible codebook or other underlying meaning has not been identified or decoded. No numerical assignment, quantity interpretation or translation is supplied.

prior_attribution_check.key_credit: Unchanged published Nov4–6 key with original provenance.

limits: The source-defined three-part 200/220/212 sequence is retained. No frame, source insertion/deletion or key change is used.
Only the invalid B glyph is filled, selecting N in NR. There are zero observed-coordinate substitutions in the primary edition.
Raw YU, NACAR, GROSZ and ER fields remain literal, as do all references and numeric groups. The readable layer does not silently convert EZ to EX.
The CUJOMAREMO marker and twelve five-figure groups are left opaque. Recovering them from ADFGVX is not a solution of any underlying code or an interpretation of their digits as quantities.
The leading 0 in 04376 and every other group character is preserved.
All six raw A2 completion witnesses are retained; N is a contextual editorial reading, not forced solely by the damaged coordinate.
The message is a routing instruction and distribution list, not proof that any shipment or transmission occurred.
Earlier candidates, the unread odd-length A1 OCR and published key provenance are preserved; no historical first-solution claim is made.
